newsitem.title: USA: CME pork bellies drop sharply on technical selling.
newsitem.headline: CME pork bellies drop sharply on technical selling.

text.p: CME pork bellies dropped sharply late in trading under pressure from technical selling and indications of weak cash prices, traders said.

Futures, already weighed down by a mildly bearish out-of-town report, tumbled on talk that bellies were going into storage instead of into users' hands. This took prices down through technical support and touched off technical sell stops, traders said.
May was down as much 2.250 cents before finding support. At 1301 CST, May was off 2.200 at 74.300 cents per pound.
